findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要競爭對手為 Siemens、ABB、Schneider、Emerson、Mitsubishi Electric、Honeywell、Dassault Systemes，並稱預期競爭維持高強度，可能限制維持或提高市占的能力。
findings.excerpt: Major competitors include Siemens AG, ABB Ltd, Schneider Electric SA, Emerson Electric Co., Mitsubishi Electric Corp., Honeywell International Inc., and Dassault Systemes.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：若無法達成目標可能流失業務或價格受侵蝕；預期競爭水準維持高檔，可能限制維持或提高市占。
findings.excerpt: We expect the level of competition to remain high in the future, which could limit our ability to maintain or increase our market share or profitability.

findings.claim: ROK FQ1 2026 業績稱有信心在波動環境中取得市占。
findings.source: Quantisnow: Rockwell Automation Reports First Quarter 2026 Results

findings.claim: Citi 2026 會議上 CEO 回應 AI 顛覆疑慮，Siemens/NVIDIA 工業 AI 作業系統被視為較具威脅的競爭問題。
findings.source: Fintool: Rockwell Citi conference AI disruption
